title: Nutty Bouncy Shiro Wot
description: A flavorful and crowd-pleasing Ethiopian dish featuring roasted and blended spices with corn flour, perfect for a quick snack or meal.

ingredients.name: Roasted and ground spices
ingredients.notes: blend of berbere, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the onions and cook until lightly browned and fragrant.
Add the ginger and garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted and ground spices to the pan, stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the corn flour to the pan, stirring to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beet juice, if using, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the pan, 1 cup at a time, stirring and thinning the mixture as needed.
Continue to cook and stir the mixture until it has thickened and formed a smooth, creamy paste.
Serve the Shiro Wot hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Nutty Bouncy Shiro Wot can be served with injera bread, rice, or as a dip.
Adjust seasoning as needed with salt and black pepper.
Store leftover Shiro Wot in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
